name: Shadeling Cluster
description: Two smears of wrongness drifting low across the ground. They move like smoke — formless, slow, but the grass withers beneath them and the air goes cold where they pass. Individually fragile. Together, a creeping threat that dissolves what it touches.

name: Mawling Ambush
description: Two humanoid shapes step from the shadows — wrong in every proportion. Limbs too long, joints bending backwards. They have no faces, just an opening that radiates a field of dissolution. They reach for things. They grab. They pull.

name: The Lost Scout
description: It wears the armor of an Accord guild scout. The armor is scarred but recognizable — the guild insignia still visible on the shoulder plate. The body inside moves with terrible precision: too smooth, too rhythmic, a head that tracks too far. Once, mid-combat, it speaks a name. Not its own. Someone it loved.

name: Hollow Wisp
description: A flickering mote of corrupt light, drawn to the living. Its touch drains warmth and will.

name: Hollow Patrol
description: A hunting pack of Hollow creatures — one larger Rend flanked by two drifting shades. They move in eerie coordination, the Rend leading while the Drifts circle like pale wolves.

name: Hollow Warden
description: Something old guards the inner ruins. Taller than a man, its form shifts between solid and translucent. Where it steps, the stone darkens. It doesn't attack immediately — it watches, as if deciding whether you're a threat or a curiosity.

name: Bandit Ambush
description: Gravel shifts on the slope above — too deliberate for an animal. Figures rise from cover with crossbows half-raised, and a broad-shouldered captain steps onto the road. "Coin and cargo," he calls, almost bored. "Or we do this the loud way."

name: Ashmark Patrol
description: Boots in lockstep, grey tabards stiff with road dust. A Thornwatch patrol fans into a clean line, the sergeant reading you before a word is spoken. Whether their hands stay near their hilts depends entirely on what your name means to the Thornwatch.

name: Cult Cell
description: Tallow smoke and a low chant coil out of the chamber. Hooded cultists ring a defaced altar while two fanatics sway in prayer, and at the back a robed leader traces a sigil that makes the air feel thin. They were expecting someone. Not you.

name: Hollow-Corrupted Settlement
description: The village still stands, after a fashion. Doors hang open on dark rooms, and the things that were neighbors drift between the houses. A Hollowed Knight stands in the square where a well used to be, mawlings circling its feet while shadelings pour from the broken windows at its silent command.
